Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 424)

Board

  • A card whose tab is closed leaves In Progress and Need Human and goes to Done, with its name and links. A card with a pull request still open stays. Cards closed earlier move once.
  • After you answer a session that asked for input, its card goes back from Need Human to In Progress. Starting another tab in the same card does not count as an answer.
  • When one tab of a split workspace closes, its card goes to Done with its own name, not the workspace name. Double-clicking it reopens its closed tab.
  • A double-click on a Board card opens its tab also when the card window was closed.
  • When Board AI changes the icons of several cards in one reply, every tab icon changes, and Undo puts all of them back.
  • Diagnostics record how many tabs were saved and restored at launch, as numbers only.

Browser and terminal

  • The browser shows a clear page when a site fails to load, with Reload. It tries again when the Mac wakes or the network comes back.
  • In the terminal, a command with a dot in its name (for example ./deploy.sh) no longer prints "bad floating point constant".
